baseline_models.focus_anchor: The k-b-r marked speakers answer with the totalizing k-l-l expression and a shared locative pronoun.
baseline_models.mechanism: A self-elevating class speaks, but comprehensive inclusion in one enclosure removes the spatial privilege its rank presumed.

activation_trace.role: Self-magnification supplies the hierarchy whose claimed elevation is cancelled by common containment.
Comprehensive inclusion gathers every member of the speaking group into one condition.

changed_reading.before: The speakers merely report that everyone is in the same place.
changed_reading.after: Their sentence is a forced admission that the hierarchy they built cannot secure a different place for its upper tier.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus places comprehensive k-l-l beside the h-k-m verb and the relational b-y-n construction.
baseline_models.mechanism: Total co-presence and adjudicative separation operate at once: sharing a location does not erase distinctions among the persons judged.

activation_trace.role: Wholeness supplies exhaustive membership in the shared condition.
Judicial decision supplies the act that assigns relations and outcomes among persons.
Separation after association prevents shared placement from becoming undifferentiated identity.
The interval among multiple parties provides the relational field in which judgment operates.

changed_reading.before: Comprehensive presence merges the parties into one undifferentiated collective.
changed_reading.after: The focus holds sameness of location together with judicial differentiation among the people located there.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Self-elevating speakers name God as judge and describe the judged parties through the a-b-d noun.
baseline_models.mechanism: The speakers' own grammar relocates superior and subordinate beneath one owner and object of obedience, undoing their claim to sovereign rank.

activation_trace.role: Rank and headship supply the social elevation that the utterance relinquishes.
The worshipped one supplies the authority above every human rank.
Owned servanthood places all disputants below the judging owner.
Submissive obedience supplies the relation that self-exaltation had denied.

changed_reading.before: The former superiors identify who issued the judgment.
changed_reading.after: In identifying the judge, they also reclassify themselves and their followers as co-servants rather than rival sovereigns.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: An answering q-w-l act terminates in the assertion that judgment has already occurred.
baseline_models.mechanism: Speech begins as negotiation between parties but invokes a completed restraining decision, converting the reply into closure rather than a new exercise of control.

activation_trace.role: Mutual discussion supplies the live bargaining frame in which this answer is delivered.
Restraint that blocks harmful action makes the prior ruling a limit on further intervention.
Adjudication supplies the completed decision that closes the exchange.

changed_reading.before: The reply gives information about a divine verdict.
changed_reading.after: The reply also closes bargaining: those once able to issue orders now cite a prior ruling that prevents them from acting.

context_deltas.mechanism: Followers ask former superiors to absorb or remove an assigned portion; the totalizing reply reveals that rank contains no surplus capacity with which punishment can be redistributed.

activation_trace.role: Leadership and elevated rank anchor the addressees as the former patrons.
Comprehensive inclusion denies an exempt upper tier from which aid could be transferred.
Ordered allegiance supplies the earlier leader-dependent bond now being tested.
Lack of strength identifies the dependent side of the failed hierarchy.
Sufficiency and protective capacity define exactly what followers ask the leaders to provide.
An assigned share supplies the proposed unit of transfer or reduction.

structural_cues: The immediately preceding turn moves from subordinate appeal to superior reply and asks whether a defined part of the same penalty can be removed.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies allegiance, weakness, sufficiency, and an assigned share; I infer that hierarchy had functioned as promised protection and that common containment cancels its transfer capacity. A live alternative is that the leaders merely refuse, but their exhaustive answer favors inability.

changed_reading.before: The speakers acknowledge only that leaders and followers share a destination.
changed_reading.after: They acknowledge the bankruptcy of patronage itself: superior status cannot carry, offset, or reassign even part of a follower's burden.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah's earlier judicial formula pairs each self with its own acquisition and exact accounting; therefore comprehensive co-location in the focus does not imply interchangeable agency or liability.

activation_trace.role: Total inclusion supplies common membership in the realized outcome.
Judicial decision connects the earlier accounting rule to the focus assertion.
Differentiation among associated parties preserves distinct responsibility inside common placement.
Action answered by fitting recompense supplies the judgment's distributive rule.
Each entity in its own identity supplies the unit assessed.
Acquired action supplies the person-specific basis of recompense.
Misplacing a thing from its proper setting supplies the injustice explicitly excluded from allocation.
Counting and reckoning supply the exact procedure behind the ruling.

structural_cues: An earlier day-of-judgment sequence moves from universal exposure to person-by-person recompense, excludes wrong, and ends with rapid reckoning.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a prior rule of individual recompense and the focus supplies shared placement plus judgment among parties; I infer that the earlier rule governs the later scene. A live alternative is that the focus reports location without commenting on differentiated grounds.

changed_reading.before: Because all are together, leaders and followers appear morally interchangeable.
changed_reading.after: Their common fate remains internally adjudicated: every party arrives through its own acquisition, and collective enclosure neither proves collective innocence nor identical liability.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah reserves true high rank for God, then joins human self-exaltation over worship to entry in abasement; the focus becomes the point where self-made superiors finally speak as servants under judgment.

activation_trace.role: Human self-magnification anchors the status claim reversed by the wider sequence.
Obedient servanthood names the relation the speakers had resisted.
Supreme rank and headship establish the rightful scale above human status.
Self-exaltation supplies the refusal that is explicitly opposed to worship.
Worship as submissive obedience identifies what pride rejects.
Entry into an interior supplies the realized spatial reversal of claimed elevation.
Abasement supplies the terminal posture of those who had magnified themselves.

structural_cues: The surah first locates greatness with God and later makes refusal of worship lead to entry in abasement; the focus speakers stand between those poles.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated k-b-r and a-b-d forms plus the sequence from refusal to abasement; I infer a confessional status reversal in the focus. A live alternative is thematic recurrence without conscious self-recognition, though the speakers' own servant-language supports the stronger reading.

changed_reading.before: The arrogant identify God as judge while retaining their identity as a distinct superior class.
changed_reading.after: Their answer performs a late self-demotion: the self-elevated now admit the servant category and occupy the abasement that refusal of service produced.

context_deltas.mechanism: Elsewhere divine speech is followed immediately by realized being, and the arrival of divine command is followed by conclusive true judgment; by contrast, the arrogant speakers can only report an already effective act.

activation_trace.role: An uttered statement anchors the human speech act whose force is being reassessed.
A fully secured and finalized act supplies the reality their speech can acknowledge but not alter.
An utterance immediately followed by realization supplies the contrasting model of efficacious speech.
Occurrence and presence make the commanded state follow the utterance without an implementation gap.
Binding command supplies the authority that initiates final resolution.
A cutting decision supplies the conclusive execution of that authority.
Stable correspondence with reality qualifies the executed decision as true rather than arbitrary.

structural_cues: The surah contrasts many human claims and disputes with a divine utterance that becomes reality and a divine command that arrives as executed judgment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies parallel speech and decision events; I infer a hierarchy of speech acts in which divine saying effects reality while the leaders' saying merely registers it. A live alternative is a theological parallel without an intended contrast in performative force.

changed_reading.before: The focus opens with an ordinary report by the arrogant.
changed_reading.after: Their speech is the residue of lost command: those once obeyed can only verbalize the result of the one word and ruling that actually take effect.

context_deltas.mechanism: After followers fail to obtain relief from leaders, the condemned appeal through keepers for even a time-limited lightening; that appeal also fails, so the focus reply marks the first closed rung in an escalating chain of mediation.

activation_trace.role: Negotiating speech anchors the reply as one stage in a sequence of attempted appeals.
An imposed restraint supplies the barrier encountered at every higher rung.
Calling by speech moves the request upward after human patrons fail.
Reduction of weight defines the smaller relief sought in the second appeal.
A bounded duration reduces the request from escape to a temporary interval.
Repeated calling returns the petition to the petitioners without gaining mediation.
Departure from a destination makes the final prayer ineffective rather than merely unanswered by leaders.

structural_cues: Across the adjacent dialogue, appeal moves from followers to leaders, then from all those inside to keepers, and finally toward the Lord, while the requested relief shrinks.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the ordered speakers and progressively smaller requests; I infer an institutional appeal chain whose every delegated layer is blocked by the completed judgment. A live alternative is that the two requests independently illustrate futility rather than form one escalation.

changed_reading.before: The leaders give a static explanation for why they will not help.
changed_reading.after: Their answer is the first failed mediation in a sequence showing that no human rank, custodian, or redirected petition can reopen the ruling.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately before the fire dispute, entrusting the affair to God leads to one servant's protection while punishment surrounds Pharaoh's attached house; this contrast limits the focus totality to the condemned faction rather than all servants without exception.

activation_trace.role: Comprehensive inclusion remains exhaustive while requiring its local group to be identified.
Judicial separation anchors the contrast between the protected servant and the encompassed faction.
Entrusting an affair to another supplies the protected servant's transfer of reliance to God.
Active warding of harm supplies the distinct outcome granted to that servant.
Descending harm that closes around its target supplies the opposite outcome for Pharaoh's side.
People attached to and returning to a leader define the faction later divided into superiors and followers.
Punitive pain supplies the enclosure that overtakes the attached ruling house.

structural_cues: The local sequence first separates a protected believer from Pharaoh's punished house, then depicts that house's internal leader-follower dispute.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacent contrasting outcomes and then the faction's internal dispute; I infer that the focus totality is exhaustive within the condemned faction, not universal across every servant. A live alternative is that the pronoun's scope is merely local without the preceding protection scene actively delimiting it.

changed_reading.before: The totalizing expression appears to place all servants without exception in one condition.
changed_reading.after: It exhaustively includes the condemned leader-follower faction, while judgment among servants has already separated a protected person from the group punishment.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah closes with accurate-sounding belief voiced only after force is seen and declares that such belief cannot benefit; the focus statement likewise sounds theologically correct only after judgment is already manifest.

activation_trace.role: Overt speech anchors the leaders' potentially truthful but belated admission.
A finalized act supplies the temporal closure after which verbal accuracy cannot alter the case.
Direct seeing supplies the late evidentiary moment that precedes confession.
Overpowering force supplies what has become visible before belief is voiced.
Spoken confession provides a whole-surah analogue to the leaders' admission.
Avowed assent supplies content that is correct in object but defective in timing.
The explicit absence of benefit blocks conversion of late belief into relief.
A recurrent governing course makes the non-benefit a rule rather than an isolated refusal.
Passage through earlier generations supplies the rule's historical recurrence.
Servanthood places the recurring rule in the same human category named by the focus.

structural_cues: The focus marks the judgment as already completed, while the surah's closing scene explicitly places confession after sight of force and denies it saving utility.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies completed judgment in the focus and a later explicit pattern of post-vision belief without benefit; I infer temporal analogy and read the leaders' statement as belated truth. A live alternative is that they are only reporting a fact, not confessing a formerly denied truth.

changed_reading.before: The statement is merely a resigned explanation of present circumstances.
changed_reading.after: It is also a late, possibly accurate confession whose truth cannot be converted into relief once the ruling has become manifest.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah first gives mercy and knowledge unrestricted breadth over every thing, later depicts punishment closing around one faction, and finally lets that faction say all of it is inside; the focus enclosure is therefore local within a wider divine field.

activation_trace.role: Comprehensive inclusion anchors the closed set whose scale is changed by wider context.
Unconstricted breadth supplies the surah's widest containing field.
A second exhaustive totality extends that wider field to every object.
Merciful tenderness names one quality of the wider encompassing field.
Harm descending and surrounding a target supplies the narrower punitive enclosure.

structural_cues: Two totalizing constructions occur at different scales: an early unrestricted scope of mercy and knowledge and the focus's local scope inside punishment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated totality plus expansive and surrounding roots; I infer competing or nested enclosures rather than unrelated descriptions of extent. A live alternative is that the constructions share vocabulary without forming a spatial model.

changed_reading.before: The totalizing expression only counts every member inside one place.
changed_reading.after: It marks a locally closed condemned set nested within a wider field of divine mercy and knowledge, so the punitive enclosure is not the surah's ultimate horizon.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the h-k-m branch of bridle-like restraint rather than ordinary adjudication. It remains anchored in the focus verb and gains a concrete echo from later collars, linked chains, and dragging, but downstream prose should present it only as a lexical-material resonance, not as a replacement translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus h-k-m verb carried through its restraint and bridle branch.

activation_trace.role: A jaw-enclosing control that prevents free movement lets the ruling be pictured as imposed restraint.
A collar binding the body gives the abstract restraint a later material form.
Connected links extend individual restraint into an inescapable sequence.
Forced drawing and extension show the restrained body moved by another's power.

changed_reading.before: The judgment is an abstract verdict determining relations among servants.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the verdict also becomes a controlling restraint later materialized in collars, chains, and forced movement.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is form-distant because it uses the packet's secondary q-w-l to q-l-l mapping, not the dominant speech root. It remains anchored in the focus's first word and is reinforced by the failed request to lighten a burden and by the contrasting effective divine utterance; render it only as wordplay about diminished or non-lifting speech.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus q-w-l occurrence through its supplied secondary q-l-l target.

activation_trace.role: Diminution lets the leaders' once-commanding speech register as a reduced, insufficient report.
Carrying and rising activate the precise capacity their answer proves unable to supply for another's burden.
Lightening a weight supplies the neighboring action that no human speech can obtain.
Ordinary utterance on the divine side introduces the counterexample of speech that is not diminished.
Immediate occurrence supplies the efficacy missing from the leaders' statement.

changed_reading.before: The leaders' utterance plainly states their inability to help.
changed_reading.after: As contained wordplay, their saying has itself become little and unable to lift, while divine saying still brings its object into being.

strongest_changes: Shared containment is a collapse of patronage and rank, not merely a shared location.
Comprehensive co-location coexists with individualized recompense and judicial separation.
The former superiors' servant-language performs a late reversal from self-exaltation to abasement.
The reply is one failed rung in an escalating appeal chain that cannot reopen completed judgment.
The statement can be true yet savingly useless because it is voiced only after the ruling is manifest.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah recurrence turns the focus into a convergence point: political and devotional hierarchy fails as protection, totality remains internally adjudicated, and human speech loses force while divine word and judgment take effect.
remaining_uncertainties: The exact local scope of the totalizing expression is inferred from the protected-person versus punished-house sequence.
The contrast between effective divine speech and merely reporting human speech is abductive rather than explicitly announced.
The nested-enclosure model may be a recurrent spatial pattern or only parallel language of extent.
The bridle-chain and secondary q-l-l activations should remain exploratory lexical resonances.
